source: Pumps.pdf — Edmonds School District, College Place
job: Edmonds SD College Place — hydronic and condenser water pumps
provenance: Uploaded 2026-08-19. Values read off the HYDRONIC PUMP SCHEDULE text layer. The expected motor sizes are the ENGINEER'S OWN selections from the same schedule — this fixture checks the app against a professional's answer, not against itself.
why: The app selected one NEMA frame light on both pumps, because it sized the motor to brake horsepower with no non-overloading margin. A motor sized exactly to BHP overloads the moment the pump runs out on its curve.

expected.note: motorHp must equal the engineer's scheduled HP for every pump
